text: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步健全多层次资本市场体系。与实体经济全周期、差异化的金融需求相适配，推动各市场、各板块进一步完善定位、提升功能，健全多元股权融资体系。发展多层次债券市场，发挥好资产证券化和REITs盘活存量作用。健全期货市场品种布局，提升大宗商品价格影响力。
text_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the CSRC will further improve the multi-tiered capital market system. To adapt to the full-cycle and differentiated financial needs of the real economy, it will promote further improvement of positioning and functions across markets and boards, and improve the diversified equity financing system. It will develop the multi-tiered bond market and give full play to the role of asset securitization and REITs in revitalizing existing assets. It will improve the layout of futures market products and enhance the price influence of bulk commodities.
